name: Starter Custom Theme
author: Your Name
description: A clean template to start building custom OpenPlay themes with categorized settings, semantic hooks, and custom layouts.

settings.label: Theme Accent Color
settings.description: Primary highlight color for buttons, badges, rings, and focus outlines.

settings.label: Panel Tint & Windows Background
settings.description: Base dark tint for panels, drawers, modals, and container surfaces.

settings.label: Hero Banner Aspect Ratio
settings.description: Proportions of the hero artwork banner in the game details view.

settings.label: Hero Title Logo Max Width (%)
settings.description: Maximum width constraint for the game logo relative to the hero banner.

settings.label: Hero Title Logo Max Height (%)
settings.description: Maximum height constraint for the game logo relative to the hero banner.

settings.label: Game Card Corner Radius
settings.description: Corner roundness for game cover posters and thumbnails.

settings.label: Game Card Aspect Ratio
settings.description: Shape of game cover cards in the grid (e.g. Switch-style 1:1 square tiles vs 2:3 vertical posters).

settings.label: Card Hover Glow
settings.description: Luminous accent-colored ambient glow around hovered cards.

settings.label: Glassmorphism Blur
settings.description: Backdrop blur strength for modal containers, flyouts, and drawers.
